title: Shoulder abduction targets in rehabilitation
text: In shoulder abduction rehabilitation, the patient typically progresses through 90 degrees of glenohumeral abduction with a neutral scapula before adding load. Raising the arm past 120 degrees requires scapulothoracic upward rotation; shrugging or trunk lean is a compensation pattern often driven by rotator cuff weakness and can be cued by asking the patient to keep the neck long and lift with a slow tempo.
